name: Ava Latrope
biography: is a security consultant for iSEC Partners, with a focus on web application penetration testing. Her areas of interest include source code auditing, embedded device security and network penetration testing. Prior to joining iSEC, Ava worked for several years creating test automation frameworks for web 2.0 companies in the real estate and media industries. Research interests include instant messaging implementation and protocols.
